results.reason: Cold launch (random deal #962391): one tap on the exposed AC sent it to the clubs UP foundation, Moves 0->1, no confirmation, no mis-target.
Deal #10,004: one tap on the exposed KC sent it to the clubs DOWN foundation (two-ended direction correct), Moves 3->4.
Deal #10,004: tapping the head (JC) of the 3-card run JC-10H-9S relocated all three onto QD in col4 as one move (Moves 6->7).
Same run-head tap; also verified by drag: dragging the run head JC moved JC+10H together to col4. Buried non-head cards never lift (see TC-2.4).

Drop-below-column regression passes at both +20 pt (y=700) and +120 pt (y=800); free-cell and up-foundation drops land where released; release at y=860 (past the tableau area) correctly snaps back with no move.

Pickup is instant: a 0.1 s drag moved QH onto KS, so no press-and-hold. Wrong-end foundation drop (AD onto the diamonds DOWN pile) refused; occupied free cell refused without rerouting; self-column drop counts no move. One defect found on the horizontal axis: ux/WF-2:drop-gutter-dead-zone (minor).

Buried AH (col0 idx2, deal #10,004) never lifts on tap or drag, Moves unchanged, no stuck elevated card; the ~0.3 s acknowledgement wiggle was caught on film (frame f35 of a 3 fps host loop: MAD 21.2, 25.2% pixels changed over that card's rect vs 0.000 elsewhere).

Over-cueing non-goal verified: tapping the liftable-but-targetless 4H sitting in a free cell produced MAD 0.000 across all 30 filmed frames (stays silent). The 'cue suppressed during a demo line' sub-check was NOT exercised - it needs the WF-6 demo bar and belongs to that lane.

All four legs on deal #10,004: never clipped (16-card col0 bottom edge 836 pt, above the 840 pt safe-area bottom); fan compresses first (col0 pitch 30->28 at 13 cards, ->24 at 15, neighbours stay 30, card width 44-45 pt throughout).

Uniform board shrink fires on the 16th card (card width 44-45 -> 42.3 pt, pitch 49 -> 47.3, tableau re-centres: left edge 6.0 -> 14.7 pt; foundations and free cells shrink with it, never two sizes). Monotone: tapping the tall column's bottom card at (36,800) moved it (board stayed small) and Undo restored 16 cards still small; only Replay restored full size.
